jobs.occupation: Master student (d/f/m)- Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al parts (Ingenieur/in - Werkstofftechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for aMaster student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al partsYou are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development !- Location: Donauwörth- Start: As soon as possible- Duration: 3-6 monthsYour locationAt our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).- Mobile working after agreement with the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Define the optimal measurement stages and witness-specimen concepts within the L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V process chain in an on-site additive manufacturing production.- Characterize measurement repeatability, geometry influences, and the natural resonance spectrum variation of nominally processed witness specimens across manufacturing stages.- Quantify the sensitivity of specific resonance modes and spectral features to controlled process- and material-state variations (e.g., microstructural changes, residual stress, defects, post-processing deviations).- Identify robust multivariate spectral features or frequency combinations and establish preliminary screening and acceptance criteria to reliably distinguish nominal from off-nominal material states.- Validate the screening concept against reference material state data and define a practical industrial implementation envelope, specifying how PCRT complements existing NDT and quality-assurance routes.- Desired Final Deliverable:An experimentally validated PCRT quality-screening methodology, utilizing a dedicated witness specimen tracked across key L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V manufacturing stages, that defines clear acceptance criteria and limits for catching abnormal material states before costly downstream processing.Desired skills and qualifications- You are an enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) seeking a master thesis in the field of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials science, or non-destructive testing (or comparable fields).- Experience in additive manufacturing or 3D printing is beneficial.- You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset, solution-oriented thinking, independence, and a willingness to learn.- You are communicative, proficient in English, and have basic German skills.- You have the ability to work collaboratively in an international environment, liaising with development, production, industrialization, and quality assurance departments.- You are resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic and cutting-edge research topic.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.employer_name: Weierstraß-Institut für Angewandte Analysis und Stochastik (WIAS)
jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations ”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027 .Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!

At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.
